title: Figure 4: Illustration of the Casimir effect - parallel plates and vacuum fluctuations
description: Color illustration of two parallel gray plates labeled "Casimir plates" with green sinusoidal waves labeled "Vacuum fluctuations" outside and shorter waves between them, and blue arrows pushing the plates together. The caption reads "Figure 4. Illustration of the Casimir Effect." It accompanies a section titled "Quantum Vacuum Field Stress: Negative Energy From the Casimir Effect."
